local colors = {
    blue = "#8DA2DF",
    green = "#ABD040",
    stagger = "#DFC087",
    key = "#33C2FF",
    grey = "#AAAAAA",
}
for _, v in pairs(data) do
	v.text = v.text:gsub("<([^/<>]-)>", function(k)
		if colors[k] then
			return "<span style='color:"..colors[k].."'>"
		end
		return k
	end)
end

return data
